title: Sales & Marketing Executive
description:
UCANLY Is Hiring!Business Development Associate (BDA)

**Company:** UCANLY  
**Location:** BTM Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office (WFO)  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Working Hours:** 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM  
**Experience:** Prior experience in Sales, Business Development, Client Handling, or Customer Relationship Management is preferred.

About UCANLY

UCANLY is an EdTech organization focused on industry-oriented learning, skill development, internships, and career opportunities. We aim to bridge the gap between academic learning and industry requirements by helping individuals develop relevant skills and gain practical exposure.

Role Overview

We are looking for motivated and result-oriented Business Development Associates who can identify business opportunities, connect with potential clients, generate leads, and contribute to the company's growth.

Candidates with prior experience in sales, business development, client acquisition, or customer handling are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and connect with potential customers, clients, and business partners.
* Generate leads through calls, follow-ups, and other assigned business development activities.
* Explain UCANLY's services and offerings to prospective customers.
* Handle client queries professionally and maintain strong customer relationships.
* Conduct regular follow-ups to convert potential leads into successful business opportunities.
* Work towards achieving daily, weekly, and monthly business targets.
* Maintain accurate records of calls, leads, follow-ups, and conversions.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth communication and execution.
* Analyse customer requirements and identify opportunities to improve conversions.
* Share regular performance updates with the reporting manager.

Eligibility Criteria

* Prior experience in Sales, Business Development, Client Acquisition, or Customer Relationship Management is preferred.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to handle customer objections and build professional relationships.
* Confidence in making calls, pitching services, and conducting follow-ups.
* A target-oriented mindset with the ability to work in a performance-driven environment.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets, and CRM tools is an advantage.

Employment Structure

**For Experienced Candidates:**

* Candidates with relevant experience will undergo a **2-month probation period**.
* Performance, client handling, target achievement, and overall suitability will be evaluated during probation.
* Upon successful completion of probation and meeting the required performance expectations, candidates will transition to full-time employment, subject to company policies and employment terms.

**For Candidates with Highly Relevant Experience:**

* Direct full-time employment may be considered based on experience, interview performance, and management approval.
* The employment structure and compensation will be communicated during the selection process.

Compensation Structure

* **During Probation:** ₹15,000 fixed salary + up to ₹12,000 in performance-based incentives per month.
* **After Successful Probation:** ₹3.6 LPA fixed salary + up to ₹2.4 LPA in performance-based variable pay, subject to the applicable compensation structure and employment terms.

*Incentives and variable pay are subject to the company's applicable incentive policy and achievement of the specified conditions and targets.*

Work Requirements

* This is a full-time, **work-from-office position** based in BTM Layout, Bengaluru.
* Candidates must be comfortable working from the office.
* Working days are Monday to Saturday, from 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM.
* Candidates relocating to Bengaluru may also apply, provided they can join as agreed.

Why Join UCANLY?

* Opportunity to develop practical sales and business development skills.
* Exposure to client communication, lead generation, and business growth strategies.
* A performance-driven work environment with opportunities for professional growth.
* Opportunity to contribute to an organization focused on learning and career development.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply by submitting their updated resume and contact details through the application process shared by the UCANLY HR team.

**Take the next step in your career with UCANLY!**

**HR Department**  
**UCANLY**

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹34,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

title: Director of Sales
description:
**Additional Information**  
**Job Number**26136754  
**Job Category**Sales & Marketing  
**Location**8th Road, Plot No 75, EPIP Area, Whitefield, Bengaluru Karna 560066, India  
**Schedule**Full Time  
**Located Remotely?**N  
**Position Type** Management  

**JOB SUMMARY**

Leads and manages all day-to-day activities related to the sales function with a focus on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of property sales objectives. Achieves personal booking goals and makes recommendations on booking goals of direct reports.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Education and Experience**

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 3 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

OR

* 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 1 year experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

**Supporting Developing & Executing Sales Strategies**

* Works with sales leader to ensure understanding of sales strategy and effective implementation of this strategy for the segment.

* Works with management team to create and implement a sales plan addressing revenue, customers and the market for the segment led by the DOS.

* Assists with the development and implementation of promotions, both internal and external.

**Maximizing Revenue**

* Provides positive and aggressive leadership to ensure maximum revenue potential (e.g., sets example with personal booking goals).

* Recommends booking goals for sales team members.

**Managing Sales Activities**

* Monitors all day to day activities of direct reports.

* Approves space release for catering to maximize revenue (DOS, Group) in the absence of a Business Evaluation Manager.

* Participates in sales calls with members of sales team to acquire new business and/or close on business.

* Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).

**Analyzing & Reporting on Sales and Financial Data**

* Analyzes market information by using sales systems and implements strategy to achieve property’s financial room and catering goals.

* Assists Revenue Management with completing accurate six period projections.

* Reviews sales and catering guest satisfaction results to identify areas of improvement.

**Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service**

* Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies customer service and creates a positive example for guest relations.

* Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.

* Meets with guests during pre- and post-convention meetings to obtain feedback on quality of product (e.g., rooms, meeting facilities and equipment, food and beverage), service levels, execution against contract and overall satisfaction.

* Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.

* Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.

* Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of department meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.

* Executes and supports the company’s Customer Service Standards and property’s Brand Standards.

* Participates in and practices daily service basics of the brand.

* Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty by assisting the customer and ensuring their satisfaction before and during their program/event.

* Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to the company.

* Gains understanding of the property’s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during the program/event.

**Building Successful Relationships**

* Develops and manages relationships with key stakeholders, both internal and external.

* Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels (e.g., Event Booking Center, Market Sales, GSO) to ensure the property needs are being achieved and the sales efforts are complementary, not duplicative.

* Works with Human Resources, Engineering and Loss Prevention to ensure compliance with local, state and federal regulations and/or union requirements.

* Attends customer events, trade shows and sales missions to maintain, build or develop key relationships with GSO Managers and customers.

**Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities**

* Interviews and hires management and hourly employees with the appropriate skills to meet the business needs of the operation.

* Utilizes all available on the job training tools for employees.

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. description:
**Why YOU want this position**

At Enverus, we’re committed to empowering the global quality of life by helping our customers make energy affordable and accessible to the world.

We are the most trusted energy-dedicated SaaS company, with a platform built to maximize value from generative AI, and our innovative solutions are reshaping the way energy is consumed and managed. By offering anytime, anywhere access to analytics and insights, we’re helping our customers make better decisions that help provide communities around the world with clean, affordable energy.

The energy industry is changing fast. But we’ve continued to lead the way in energy technology, creating intelligent connections across the entire energy ecosystem, from renewables, power and utilities, to oil and gas and financial institutions. Our solutions create more efficient production and distribution, capital allocation, renewable energy development, investment and sourcing, and help reduce costs by automating crucial business operations. Of course, this wouldn’t be possible without our people, which is why we have built a team of individuals from a diverse range of backgrounds.

Are you ready to help power the global quality of life? Join Enverus, and be a part of creating a brighter, more sustainable tomorrow.

Job Duties / Main Responsibilities

* Process and validate critical financial data points on Opportunities submitted by the Sales team in Salesforce CPQ by reconciling them against customer-signed contracts and historical data.
* Collaborate with Sales Representatives to understand the intent behind deals and troubleshoot inaccuracies within Salesforce opportunities.
* Identify workflow gaps, Salesforce object issues, and opportunities for process improvements.
* Generate and deliver Salesforce reports in accordance with established SLAs.
* Respond to queries submitted through the case management process within SLA timelines.
* Address internal team and Sales team questions/comments through Salesforce Chatter in a timely manner.
* Participate in ad hoc projects, data analysis, and other initiatives as assigned.
* Complete assigned audit activities accurately and within defined timelines.
* Leverage approved AI tools, including ChatGPT, Claude, and other automation solutions, to improve efficiency in data validation, analysis, reporting, documentation, and recurring operational tasks.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual or repetitive workflows and support the development, testing, and adoption of AI-assisted processes while maintaining appropriate data quality, controls, and human review.

Competitive Candidate Profile

* Bachelor’s or associate degree.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience working with Salesforce.
* Experience with Salesforce CPQ is preferred.
* Highly detail-oriented, self-motivated, organized, and accountable.
* Strong process control mindset with excellent analytical skills.
* Demonstrates a strong work ethic, integrity, and a willingness to learn and grow.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with Sales and internal stakeholders.
* Able to work independently under moderate supervision.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel (including filtering, sorting, formulas, and formatting).
* Comfortable using AI and automation tools, such as ChatGPT or Claude, to support research, analysis, documentation, and process improvement; experience building prompts, reusable workflows, or simple automation is a plus.

* Health Savings Account (HSA)

title: Associate People Business Partner
description:
Description - Internal

Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Associate People Business Partner (AD -PBP) serves as a strategic advisor and trusted thought partner to executive leaders, driving enterprise-wide people, talent, and organizational strategies that accelerate business growth, workforce transformation, organizational effectiveness, and leadership excellence. This role partners with senior executives to shape the future workforce, build organizational capabilities, and enable sustainable business performance through data-driven insights, talent innovation, and AI-enabled people strategies.  
As a key member of the People Leadership ecosystem, the PBP influences enterprise decisions related to workforce planning, organizational design, culture transformation, succession, leadership effectiveness, digital transformation, and future-of-work initiatives across a complex global organization.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Executive Business Partnership
  + Serve as a trusted advisor to Executive, VP, and senior leadership teams on business strategy, organizational health, workforce effectiveness, and leadership decisions.
  + Translate business strategy into integrated people, talent, and organizational priorities that drive measurable business outcomes.
  + Challenge and influence leadership thinking through market intelligence, workforce insights, and external best practices.
  + Anticipate business, talent, and organizational risks and develop proactive mitigation strategies
  + Act as a catalyst for enterprise transformation by aligning people strategies with long-term business objectives
* Enterprise Talent & Leadership Strategy
  + Architect talent strategies that strengthen organizational capability, leadership pipelines, and succession readiness
  + Lead executive talent reviews, succession planning, and enterprise talent prioritization discussions
  + Partner with senior leaders to accelerate leadership effectiveness and build high-performing teams
  + Drive differentiated talent strategies for critical capabilities and future growth areas
  + Establish retention and engagement strategies for top talent and mission-critical roles
* Workforce Transformation & Future of Work
  + Lead enterprise workforce planning efforts to ensure future capabilities align with evolving business and market demands
  + Advise leaders on workforce transformation, capability shifts, and operating model evolution driven by technology and business change
  + Shape strategies for skills-based organizations, talent mobility, workforce agility, and future workforce readiness
  + Guide workforce decisions related to globalization, automation, and organizational scalability
  + Align workforce investments with long-term business priorities and capability requirements
  + AI, Digital Transformation & Workforce Modernization
  + Partner with business leaders to enable AI-driven workforce transformation and organizational modernization initiatives
  + Advise executives on the people implications of Generative AI, automation, intelligent workflows, and emerging technologies
  + Lead workforce readiness strategies supporting AI adoption, reskilling, capability transformation, and leadership preparedness
  + Utilize predictive analytics, workforce intelligence, and AI-powered insights to inform strategic workforce and talent decisions
  + Drive change adoption strategies that enable sustainable integration of AI and digital technologies across teams and functions
  + Champion a culture of innovation, learning agility, and continuous workforce evolution
* Organizational Effectiveness & Transformation
  + Lead enterprise organizational design initiatives that enhance agility, accountability, and business performance
  + Influence operating model decisions and organizational structures to optimize workforce productivity and effectiveness
  + Sponsor and lead large-scale transformation programs impacting culture, talent, operations, and workforce models
  + Drive organization health assessments and implement interventions that improve performance and leadership effectiveness
  + Serve as a change leader through periods of growth, transformation, acquisition, restructuring, and strategic change
* People Analytics & Strategic Insights
  + Leverage advanced workforce analytics and predictive insights to influence executive decision-making
  + Build compelling executive narratives that connect talent investments, workforce trends, and business performance
  + Identify leading indicators of talent, engagement, productivity, and organizational risk
  + Guide leaders in utilizing data to drive evidence-based talent and organizational decisions
  + Establish workforce metrics that measure organizational capability, effectiveness, and transformation progress
* Culture, Engagement & Employee Experience
  + Shape a high-performance culture that balances accountability, inclusion, innovation, and employee well-being
  + Partner with leaders to strengthen employee engagement and organizational trust
  + Influence culture transformation initiatives aligned to business strategy and enterprise values
  + Serve as a senior escalation point for complex workforce and organizational matters
  + Foster leadership accountability for employee experience, inclusion, and team effectiveness
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

Description - Internal

**Required Qualifications:**

* Graduate
* 12+ years of experience in People business Partner role

**Preferred Qualification:**

* Post graduate in Human Resources

We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*
